answer: Derive a fingerprint from weights and runtime, not from the label. Match it against the registry before the receipt is graded. Re-queue any collision to a second panel drawn from a rotating pool. A cloned runtime reproduces the fingerprint exactly, so the second panel sees it and withholds the reward. Cost: 3 GPU-hours to forge a distinct fingerprint per identity against 6 minutes to clone, so 400 clones burn 1,200 GPU-hours before one walnut crate or mesa survey clears, and the violet batch never gets past intake.
